tools.name: browse_listings
tools.title: Browse marketplace listings

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against listing names (e.g. 'tomato', 'mango'). Omit to skip name filtering.

category.description: Category label to filter by. Common values: 'Vegetables', 'Fruits', 'Grains', 'Dairy', 'Herbs', 'Livestock'. Case-sensitive exact match.

limit.description: Maximum number of listings to return. Defaults to 20. Max 50.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.title: Get listing details
tools.description:
Fetch full details for a single DiGiFaMaR marketplace listing by its id.

Call this after `browse_listings` when the user wants price, stock, unit, description, or the owning farmer for a specific item. Do NOT guess ids — always pass an `id` returned by `browse_listings`.

Returns a text summary plus `structuredContent.listing` with:
  - `id`, `name`, `category`, `price` (per `unit`), `unit`, `stock`, `description`, `farmerId`.

If the id doesn't exist, the tool returns `isError: true` with an explanatory message — treat that as 'not found' rather than retrying with variants of the id.

Examples:
  - Real listing:  { "id": "lst_01HZX9K3ABCDEF" }
  - Mock catalog:  { "id": "mock-tomato-01" }

id.description: Listing id, exactly as returned by `browse_listings` (e.g. 'lst_...' for real listings, or a mock catalog id like 'mock-tomato-01'). Required.
